<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Completion of Acquisition or Disposition of Assets. </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="10%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Item&nbsp;3.02</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Unregistered Sales of Equity Securities. </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On
October&nbsp;6, 2008, Advanced Micro Devices, Inc. (the &#147;<B><I>Company</I></B>&#148;) entered into a Master Transaction Agreement (as amended on December&nbsp;5, 2008, the &#147;<B><I>Master Transaction Agreement</I></B>&#148;) with Advanced
Technology Investment Company LLC, a limited liability company established under the laws of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi and wholly owned by the Government of the Emirate of Abu Dhabi (&#147;<B><I>ATIC</I></B>&#148;), and West Coast Hitech L.P., an
exempted limited partnership organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands (&#147;<B><I>WCH</I></B>&#148;), acting through its general partner, West Coast Hitech G.P., Ltd., a corporation organized under the laws of the Cayman Islands, pursuant to
which ATIC and the Company agreed to form a manufacturing joint venture, The Foundry Company, an exempted company to be incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands (&#147;<B><I>The Foundry Company</I></B>&#148;). The Foundry Company will
manufacture semiconductor products and will provide certain foundry services to the Company and in the future to other third-party customers. On March&nbsp;4, 2009, The Foundry Company changed its name to &#147;GLOBALFOUNDRIES Inc.&#148; </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On March&nbsp;2, 2009, the Company, ATIC and WCH consummated the transactions contemplated by the Master Transaction Agreement (the
&#147;<B><I>Closing</I></B>&#148;). At the Closing, the Company contributed certain assets and liabilities to The Foundry Company, including, among other things, shares of the groups of German subsidiaries owning Fab 30/38 and Fab 36 (the
&#147;<B><I>Dresden Subsidiaries</I></B>&#148;), certain manufacturing assets, owned real property, tangible personal property, employees, inventories, books and records, a portion of the Company&#146;s patent portfolio and intellectual property and
technology, rights under certain material contracts and authorizations necessary for The Foundry Company to carry on its business, in exchange for Foundry Company securities, consisting of one Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Share, 1,090,950 Class&nbsp;A
Preferred Shares and 700,000 Class B Preferred Shares, and the assumption of certain liabilities by The Foundry Company. ATIC contributed $1.4 billion of cash to The Foundry Company in exchange for Foundry Company securities, consisting of one
Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Share, 218,190 Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares, 172,760 Class B Preferred Shares, $201,810,000 aggregate principal amount of Class&nbsp;A Subordinated Convertible Notes and $807,240,000 aggregate principal amount of Class B
Subordinated Convertible Notes, and transferred $700 million of cash to the Company in exchange for the transfer by the Company of 700,000 Class B Preferred Shares of The Foundry Company to ATIC. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">At the Closing, the Company also issued to WCH, for an aggregate purchase price of $124,700,000, 58&nbsp;million shares of the Company&#146;s common
stock (the &#147;<B><I>Shares</I></B>&#148;) and warrants to purchase 35&nbsp;million shares of the Company&#146;s common stock (the &#147;<B><I>Warrants</I></B>&#148;) at an exercise price of $0.01 per share. The Warrants are exercisable after the
earlier of (i)&nbsp;public ground-breaking of The Foundry Company&#146;s planned manufacturing facility in New York and (ii)&nbsp;March 2, 2011, and the Warrants expire on March&nbsp;2, 2019. In the Master Transaction Agreement, WCH represented to
the Company that WCH was an &#147;accredited investor&#148; as such term is defined under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the &#147;<B><I>Securities Act</I></B>&#148;), and the Company has relied on the exemption provided by
Section&nbsp;4(2)&nbsp;of the Securities Act from the registration requirements of the Securities Act with respect to the sale and issuance of the Shares and the Warrants to WCH. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In connection with the Closing, the terms of the &#128;700,000,000 Term Loan Facility Agreement, dated as
of April&nbsp;21, 2004, as amended by amendment agreements dated October&nbsp;10, 2006 and February&nbsp;25, 2009, among AMD Fab&nbsp;36 Limited Liability Company&nbsp;&amp; Co. KG (&#147;<B><I>AMD Fab&nbsp;36 KG</I></B>&#148;), certain affiliates
of AMD Fab&nbsp;36 KG (collectively, the &#147;<B><I>Fab 36 German Companies</I></B>&#148;), the banks and financial institutions party thereto as Mandated Lead Arrangers or Lenders, Dresdner Bank AG in Berlin, as Security Agent and Reporting Agent,
and Dresdner Bank AG, Niederlassung Luxemburg, as Facility Agent (collectively, the &#147;<B><I>Facility Agreement</I></B>&#148;) and related agreements were amended to allow for the transfer of the Fab 36 German Companies (including the Facility
Agreement and related agreements and the indebtedness outstanding thereunder) to The Foundry Company, whose financial results will continue to be consolidated in the Company&#146;s financial statements. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In connection with the Closing, the Company also amended the terms of its Guarantee Agreement, dated as of April&nbsp;21, 2004, as amended by amendment
agreements dated October&nbsp;10, 2006 and February&nbsp;25, 2009, among the Company and The Foundry Company, as guarantors, AMD Fab 36 KG, as Borrower, Dresdner Bank AG in Berlin, as Security Agent, Dresdner Bank AG, Niederlassung Luxemburg, as
Facility Agent, and AMD Netherlands Technologies BV, a subsidiary of The Foundry Company (the &#147;<B><I>Guarantee Agreement</I></B>&#148;). Pursuant to the Guarantee Agreement, the Company and The Foundry Company are joint guarantors, including
with respect to the amounts payable by AMD Fab 36 KG under the Facility Agreement and the related agreements. However, if the Company is called upon to make any payments under the Guarantee Agreement, The Foundry Company has separately agreed to
indemnify the Company for the full amount of such payments. The Company must continue to comply with the covenants set forth in the Guarantee Agreement, including specified adjusted tangible net worth and EBITDA financial covenants if group
consolidated cash declines below the following amounts: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>Shareholders&#146; Agreement</U> </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Shareholders&#146; Agreement sets forth the rights and obligations of the Company and ATIC as shareholders of The Foundry Company. The initial Foundry
Company board of directors (the &#147;<B><I>Foundry Company Board</I></B>&#148;) consists of eight directors, and the Company and ATIC each designated four directors for nomination. The number of directors a Foundry Company shareholder may designate
may decrease in the future according to the percentage of The Foundry Company shares it owns on a fully diluted basis. Doug Grose is the initial Foundry Company Chief Executive Officer and Bruce McDougall is the initial Foundry Company Chief
Financial Officer. Hector de J. Ruiz will not be a director of The Foundry Company but will serve as Chairman of the Foundry Company Board. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">Pursuant to the Shareholders&#146; Agreement, The Foundry Company is not allowed to take certain corporate actions without unanimous Foundry Company Board approval, including, among other things: (i)&nbsp;entering into any transaction
resulting in a change of control of The Foundry Company or any sale of all or substantially all of the assets of The Foundry Company and its subsidiaries; (ii)&nbsp;approving any annual business plan or any material amendment, modification or
revision of any annual business plan; (iii)&nbsp;authorizing, issuing, selling, acquiring, converting, repurchasing or redeeming any Foundry Company shares or other equity interest not reflected in the annual business plan, its Articles of
Association or any incentive plan; (iv)&nbsp;making certain capital expenditures not reflected in the annual business plan; (v)&nbsp;incurring indebtedness over a specified level; and (vi)&nbsp;prosecuting, commencing or settling litigation in
excess of $10 million. The Shareholders&#146; Agreement also sets forth procedures by which any deadlock with respect to matters requiring Foundry Company Board approval are to be resolved, which allows a shareholder to break specified Foundry
Company Board deadlocks if it owns more than 75% or, for certain additional matters, 90% of The Foundry Company shares on a fully diluted basis. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">The Shareholders&#146; Agreement restricts the ability of each shareholder to sell any Foundry Company securities, subject to certain exceptions, including the sale of specified percentages of a shareholder&#146;s fully diluted shares of
The Foundry Company in the event of a Foundry Company initial public offering. In the event of a change of control of the Company without ATIC&#146;s prior written consent, among other things, all transfer restrictions with respect to Foundry
Company securities held by ATIC will cease and ATIC will have the right to require any acquirer of the Company to guarantee all of the Company&#146;s obligations under the transaction documents. If a change of control of the Company occurs within
two years of Closing, ATIC will have the right to put any or all of the Foundry Company securities (valued at their fair market value) held by ATIC and its permitted transferees to the Company in exchange for cash, or if a change of control of the
Company occurs after a specified event, ATIC will have the option to purchase in cash any or all of The Foundry Company securities (valued at their fair market value) held by the Company and its permitted transferees. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Shareholders&#146; Agreement may be terminated (i)&nbsp;upon dissolution of The Foundry Company, (ii)&nbsp;by written agreement of all parties
possessing rights under the Shareholders&#146; Agreement, (iii)&nbsp;at the election of a shareholder upon a bankruptcy event of the other shareholder, or (iv)&nbsp;for any shareholder, at such time the shareholder ceases to own any Foundry Company
securities. </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>Funding Agreement</U> </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Funding Agreement provides for the future funding of The Foundry Company and governs the terms and conditions under which ATIC is obligated to provide
such funding. Pursuant to the Funding Agreement, ATIC has committed to additional equity funding of a minimum of $3.6 billion and up to $6.0 billion over the next five years. The Company has the right, but not the obligation, to provide additional
future capital to the Foundry Company in an amount pro rata to the Company&#146;s interest in the fully converted common stock of The Foundry Company. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">At each equity funding, the equity securities to be issued by The Foundry Company will consist of 20% of Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares and 80% of Class B Preferred Shares. The aggregate amount of equity funding to be
provided by the shareholders in any fiscal year depends on the time period of such funding (Phase I, II or III) and the amounts set forth in the five-year capital plan of The Foundry Company. The Phases are defined as follows: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD WIDTH="1%" VALIGN="top"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Phase I: the period commencing on March&nbsp;2, 2009 and ending on the last day of the fiscal year ending in 2010. </FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P
STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

thereof. </FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Foundry Company is required to obtain specified third-party debt in any given fiscal year, as set forth in
the five-year capital plan. To the extent that The Foundry Company obtains more than the specified amount of third-party debt, ATIC is able to reduce its funding commitment accordingly. To the extent that The Foundry Company is not able to obtain
the full amount of third-party debt, ATIC is not obligated to make up the difference. To the extent the Company chooses not to participate in an equity financing of The Foundry Company, ATIC is obligated to purchase such Foundry Company securities
in such equity financing, subject to ATIC&#146;s funding commitments under the Funding Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">ATIC&#146;s obligations to provide
funding are subject to certain conditions, including the accuracy of The Foundry Company&#146;s representations and warranties in the Funding Agreement, the absence of a material adverse effect on The Foundry Company or the Company and the absence
of a material breach or default by The Foundry Company or the Company under the provisions of any transaction document. There are additional funding conditions for each of the Phases. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Funding Agreement will terminate upon the termination of a transition period beginning on the date of notice of ATIC&#146;s election to have The
Foundry Company enter into such a period if certain terms and conditions contained in the Funding Agreement are satisfied and ending on the later of (A)&nbsp;12 months after such date and (B)&nbsp;the last day of the fiscal year ending in 2013.
</FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B><U>Wafer Supply Agreement</U> </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Wafer Supply Agreement governs the terms by which the Company will purchase products manufactured by The Foundry Company. Pursuant to the Wafer Supply
Agreement, the Company will, subject to limited exceptions, purchase all of its microprocessor unit (&#147;<B><I>MPU</I></B>&#148;) product requirements from The Foundry Company. If the Company acquires a third-party business that manufactures MPU
products, the Company will have up to two years to transition the manufacture of such MPU products to The Foundry Company. In addition, once The Foundry Company establishes a 32nm-qualified process, the Company will purchase from Foundry Company
sales entities, where competitive, specified percentages of its graphics processor unit (&#147;<B><I>GPU</I></B>&#148;) requirements at all process nodes, which percentages will increase linearly over a five-year period. At the Company&#146;s
request, The Foundry Company will also provide sort services to the Company on a product-by-product basis. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Company will provide The
Foundry Company with product forecasts of its MPU and GPU product requirements. The price for MPU products is related to the percentage of the Company&#146;s MPU-specific total cost of goods sold. The price for GPU products will be determined by the
parties when The Foundry Company is able to begin manufacturing GPU products for the Company. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Wafer Supply Agreement will be in effect
no longer than May&nbsp;2, 2024. The Wafer Supply Agreement may also be terminated if and when a business plan deadlock exists and ATIC elects to enter into a transition period pursuant to the Funding Agreement. The Foundry Company will agree to use
commercially reasonable efforts to assist the Company to transition the supply of products to another provider, and continue to fulfill purchase orders for up to two years following the termination or expiration of the Wafer Supply Agreement. During
such transition period, pricing for MPU products will remain as set forth in the Wafer Supply Agreement, but the Company&#146;s purchase commitments to The Foundry Company will no longer apply. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The foregoing summaries of the Facility Agreement, the Guarantee Agreement, the Shareholders&#146; Agreement, the Funding Agreement and the Wafer Supply
Agreement are qualified in their entirety by reference to the Facility Agreement, the Guarantee Agreement, the Shareholders&#146; Agreement, the Funding Agreement and the Wafer Supply Agreement attached hereto as Exhibits 10.1, 10.2, 10.3, 10.4 and
10.5, respectively, which are incorporated herein by reference. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">that change shall be reversed with retrospective effect, the Margin applicable to the Facility shall be that justified by the
correct Credit Rating, amounts of interest calculated by reference to the changed Margin (whether or not already paid) shall be recalculated by reference to the Margin applicable to such correct Credit Rating and the Borrower or the Lenders, as the
case may be, shall be required to make a payment to the Facility Agent, in such amounts as the Facility Agent may specify, to cover any difference in amounts of interest which should have actually been received by the Lenders following any
recalculation. The Facility Agent&#146;s determination of any such difference shall, save in the case of manifest error, be conclusive and the Facility Agent shall provide the Borrower and the Lenders with reasonable details of the calculation of
such difference in Margin. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>No Margin Ratchets in Events of Default</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">No reduction in the Margin provided for by Clause 8.2 (<I>Margin Ratchets</I>) shall take effect immediately from the date determined by the Facility Agent as being the date on
which an Event of Default has occurred or come into existence. The Margin shall thereafter immediately convert to the Safety Margin (if it is not already) until the date specified by the Facility Agent as being the date on which it has been
demonstrated to its reasonable satisfaction that such Event of Default is no longer continuing. The Margin shall thereafter be determined in accordance with Clause 8.2 (<I>Margin Ratchets</I>) on the basis of the Credit Rating then applicable.
</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

interest on each Loan on the last day of each Interest Period (and, if the Interest Period is longer than three (3)&nbsp;Months, on the dates falling at three (3)&nbsp;monthly intervals after the first day of the Interest Period). </FONT></P> <P

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Borrower shall be in payment default (<I>Verzug</I>) if it fails to pay any amount (other than in payment of interest and fees, other than the commitment fees under Clause 11.1
(<I>Commitment Fee</I>)) payable by it under a Finance Document on its due date. On the occurrence of such a payment default (<I>Verzug</I>), interest shall accrue on the overdue amount from the due date up to the date of actual payment (both before
and after judgment) at a rate one (1)&nbsp;<I>per cent</I>. higher than the rate which would have been payable if the overdue amount had, during the period of non-payment, constituted a Loan in the currency of the overdue amount for successive
Interest Periods, each of a duration selected by the Facility Agent (acting reasonably). Any interest accruing under this Clause&nbsp;8.6 shall be immediately payable by the Borrower on demand by the Facility Agent. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P

the account of the relevant Lenders in an amount determined by the Facility Agent as being, in respect of the period from the due date of payment until receipt by the Facility Agent of the relevant amount, the equivalent of interest at a rate

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SECTION 6 </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Definitions</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In this Clause&nbsp;12: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;<B>Protected
Party</B>&#148; means a Lender that is or will be subject to any liability, or required to make any payment, for or on account of Tax in relation to a sum received or receivable (or any sum deemed for the purposes of Tax to be received or
receivable) under a Finance Document. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;<B>Tax Credit</B>&#148; means a credit against, relief or remission for, or repayment of, any
Tax. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;<B>Tax Deduction</B>&#148; means a deduction or withholding for or on account of Tax from a payment under a Finance Document.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">&#147;<B>Tax Payment</B>&#148; means an increased payment made by the Borrower to a Lender under Clause&nbsp;12.2 (<I>Tax Gross-up</I>) or
a payment under Clause&nbsp;12.3 (<I>Tax Indemnity</I>). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In this Clause&nbsp;12 a reference to &#147;<B>determines</B>&#148; or &#147;<B>determined</B>&#148; means a determination made in the absolute discretion of the person making the

increased to an amount which (after making any Tax Deduction) leaves an amount equal to the payment which would have been due if no Tax Deduction had been required. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Borrower is not required to make an increased payment to a Lender under paragraph (c)&nbsp;above for a Tax Deduction in respect of any payment which is capable of attracting a
Tax Deduction, if on the date on which the payment falls due: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">the payment could have been made to the relevant Lender without the Tax Deduction if it was a Qualifying Lender, but on that date that Lender is not </FONT>
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">52 </FONT></P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"> <P>
<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">or has ceased to be a Qualifying Lender other than as a result of any change after the date it became a Lender under this Agreement in (or in the
interpretation, administration or application of) any law or Treaty, or any published practice or concession of any relevant taxing authority; or </FONT></P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">the Borrower is able to demonstrate that the payment could have been made to that Lender without the Tax Deduction had that Lender complied with its obligations under paragraph

Security Agent agrees with each other Finance Party (on a several and divided basis) that, subject as set out in the next sentence, it will not exercise its rights under the Acknowledgement with a Finance Party except with the consent of the
relevant Finance Party. However, for the avoidance of doubt, nothing in the previous sentence shall in any way limit the Security Agent&#146;s right to act in the protection or preservation of rights under or to enforce any Security Document as
contemplated by this Agreement and/or the relevant Security Document (or to do any act reasonably incidental to the foregoing). </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

Payment</B>&#148;) </FONT>
</P></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">equal to such receipt or recovery less any amount which the Facility Agent determines may be retained by the Recovering Finance Party as its share of any

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SECTION 10 </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>27.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>PAYMENT MECHANICS </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">27.1</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Payments to the Facility Agent</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="4%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">On each date on which an Obligor or a Lender is required to make a payment under a Finance Document, that Obligor (subject to Clause&nbsp;27.9 (<I>Payments to the Security
Agent</I>)) or that Lender shall make the same available to the Facility Agent (unless a contrary indication appears in a Finance Document) for value on the due date at the time and in such funds specified by the Facility Agent as being customary at
the time for settlement of transactions in the relevant currency in the place of payment. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Payment shall be made to such account in the principal financial centre of the country of that currency (or, in relation to EUR or USD, in a principal financial centre in a
Participating Member State or London) with such bank as the Facility Agent specifies. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

received by the Facility Agent under the Finance Documents for another Party shall, subject to Clause&nbsp;27.3 (<I>Distributions to an Obligor</I>), Clause&nbsp;27.4 (<I>Clawback</I>) and Clause&nbsp;27.9 (<I>Payments to the Security Agent</I>), be
made available by the Facility Agent as soon as practicable after receipt to the Party entitled to receive payment in accordance with this Agreement (in the case of a Lender, for the account of its Facility Office), to such account as that Party may
notify to the Facility Agent by not less than five (5)&nbsp;Business Days&#146; notice with a bank in the principal financial centre of the country of that currency (or, in relation to EUR, in a principal financial centre in a Participating Member
State or London). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

the Security Agent may (with the consent of the Obligor or in accordance with Clause&nbsp;28 (<I>Set-Off</I>)) apply any amount received by it for that Obligor in or towards payment (on the date and in the currency and funds of receipt) of any
amount due from that Obligor under the Finance Documents or in or towards purchase of any amount of any currency to be so applied. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">27.4</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Clawback</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="4%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Where a sum is to be paid to the Facility Agent or the Security Agent under the Finance Documents for another Party, the Facility Agent or, as the case may be, the Security Agent is
not obliged to pay that sum to that other Party (or to enter into or perform any related exchange contract) until it has been able to establish to its satisfaction that it has actually received that sum. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P
STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="4%"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></TD>
<TD WIDTH="4%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b)</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If the Facility Agent or the Security Agent pays an amount to another Party and it proves to be the case that it had not actually received that amount, then the Party to whom that
amount (or the proceeds of any related exchange contract) was paid shall on demand refund the same to the Facility Agent or, as the case may be, the Security Agent, together with interest on that amount from the date of payment to the date of
receipt by the Facility Agent or, as the case may be, the Security Agent, calculated by it to reflect its cost of funds. </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">27.5</FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Partial Payments</B> </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">any other act, fact, event or omission which but for this provision might operate to discharge, impair or otherwise affect the Guarantors&#146; liability hereunder.
</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:12px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B></B>6.2<B></B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>Unrestricted Right of Enforcement </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The
Guarantors&#146; obligations hereunder are in addition to and not in substitution for any Collateral Security which the Security Agent may now or hereafter hold. This Guarantee Agreement may be enforced without the Security Agent first having
recourse to any such Collateral Security and without having to take any steps or proceedings or exhaust any rights against the Borrower or any Other Surety, or may be enforced for any balance due to the Security Agent after having resorted to any
one or more such means of obtaining payment and discharge of all or any part of the Guarantors&#146; Liabilities. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="font-size:18px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The Guarantors, as joint and several debtors (<I>als Gesamtschuldner</I>), shall (within three (3)&nbsp;Business Days of demand by the Security Agent) pay to the Protected Party an

<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:13%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">if in either case that Tax is imposed on or calculated by reference to the net income received or receivable (but not any sum deemed to be received or

<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If a Guarantor makes a Tax Payment and the relevant Lender determines that: </FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="font-size:6px;margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">&nbsp;</P>
<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">

Date, each Lender shall promptly give notice to the Guarantors (through the Security Agent) if it becomes aware that circumstances have occurred as a result of which it is not a Qualifying Lender. </FONT></P> <P

<TABLE STYLE="BORDER-COLLAPSE:COLLAPSE" BORDER="0" CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%">
<TR>
<TD WIDTH="5%" VALIGN="top" ALIGN="left"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>8.</B></FONT></TD>
<TD ALIGN="left" VALIGN="top"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>CURRENCY INDEMNITY </B></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">If any amount is received by
the Security Agent in a currency other than that in which the relevant obligation or liability of that Guarantor was payable (the &#147;<B>Required Currency</B>&#148;) (whether pursuant to a judgment, in the Insolvency of that Guarantor or
otherwise), such obligation or liability shall be discharged only to the extent that an Agent is able, upon receipt of such amount, to purchase the Required Currency with such other currency in accordance with the usual banking procedures of the
Security Agent. If the amount in the Required Currency which may be so purchased is, after deducting any costs of exchange and any other related costs, less than the amount of the relevant obligation or liability, the relevant Guarantor shall, as a
separate and independent obligation and notwithstanding any time or other indulgence granted to that Guarantor or any other act, matter or thing, forthwith pay to the Security Agent the amount of the shortfall. </FONT></P> <P

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>SHAREHOLDERS&#146; AGREEMENT </B></FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">This SHAREHOLDERS&#146; AGREEMENT (this &#147;<I>Shareholders&#146; Agreement</I>&#148; and as referred to herein, this &#147;<I>Agreement</I>&#148;),
dated as of March 2, 2009 is entered into by and among Advanced Micro Devices, Inc., a Delaware corporation (&#147;<I>Discovery</I>&#148;), Advanced Technology Investment Company LLC, a limited liability company established under the laws of the
Emirate of Abu Dhabi and wholly-owned by the Government of Abu Dhabi (&#147;<I>Oyster</I>&#148;) (each of Discovery and Oyster being a &#147;<I>Shareholder</I>&#148; and together the &#147;<I>Shareholders</I>&#148;), and The Foundry Company, an
exempted company incorporated under the laws of the Cayman Islands (&#147;<I>FoundryCo</I>&#148;). Discovery, Oyster and FoundryCo are sometimes referred to herein as the &#147;<I>Parties</I>&#148;, and each individually as a
&#147;<I>Party</I>&#148;. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2"><B>RECITALS </B></FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, Discovery, Oyster and the other parties thereto are parties to the Master Transaction Agreement that provides, among other things, for the formation of FoundryCo under the laws of the Cayman Islands to act as
the holding company for a joint venture between Discovery and Oyster; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Master Transaction Agreement and
immediately prior to the execution of this Agreement, Discovery has contributed or caused its Subsidiaries to contribute to FoundryCo, and FoundryCo has acquired from Discovery and its Subsidiaries, the FoundryCo Assets in consideration of the
issuance by FoundryCo to Discovery (or a Subsidiary of Discovery) of an amount of Shares as stated in the Master Transaction Agreement and the assumption of the Assumed Liabilities by FoundryCo and its Subsidiaries; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, pursuant to the Master Transaction Agreement and immediately prior to the execution of this Agreement, Oyster (i)&nbsp;has contributed cash to
FoundryCo in consideration of the issuance by FoundryCo to Oyster of an amount of Shares as stated in the Master Transaction Agreement and the issuance of the Initial Convertible Notes and (ii)&nbsp;has contributed cash to Discovery in consideration
of the transfer by Discovery to Oyster of an amount of Shares as stated in the Master Transaction Agreement; and </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">WHEREAS, Discovery,
Oyster and FoundryCo will have entered into the Funding Agreement pursuant to which Oyster has committed to, and Discovery has the option to, make additional capital contributions, in accordance with the terms thereof, to FoundryCo in exchange for
additional Preferred Shares and/or Additional Convertible Notes. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">NOW, THEREFORE, in consideration of the premises and the mutual
agreements and covenants hereinafter set forth, and intending to be legally bound, the Parties hereby agree as follows: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">ARTICLE I
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">DEFINITIONS </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;1.01
<I>Certain Defined Terms</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">Capitalized terms used and not otherwise defined in this Agreement shall have the respective meanings
referred to or ascribed to such terms in Appendix A. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;1.02 <I>Interpretation and Rules of Construction</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">In this Agreement, except to the extent otherwise provided or that the context otherwise requires: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) when a reference is made in this Agreement to an Article, Section, Exhibit or Schedule, such reference is to an Article or Section of, or a Schedule
or Exhibit to, this Agreement unless otherwise indicated; </FONT></P>

<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) the table of contents and headings for this Agreement are for reference purposes only and do not
affect in any way the meaning or interpretation of this Agreement; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) whenever the words &#147;include,&#148; &#147;includes&#148; or
&#147;including&#148; are used in this Agreement, they are deemed to be followed by the words &#147;without limitation&#148;; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(d) the
words &#147;hereof,&#148; &#147;herein&#148; and &#147;hereunder&#148; and words of similar import, when used in this Agreement, refer to this Agreement as a whole and not to any particular provision of this Agreement; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(e) all terms defined in this Agreement have the defined meanings when used in any certificate or other document made or delivered pursuant hereto,
unless otherwise defined therein; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(f) the definitions contained in this Agreement are applicable to the singular as well as the plural
forms of such terms; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(g) whenever the context may require, any pronoun shall include the corresponding masculine, feminine and neuter
forms; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(h) any Law defined or referred to herein or in any agreement or instrument that is referred to herein means such Law or statute as
from time to time amended, modified or supplemented, including by succession of comparable successor Laws, and any rules and regulations promulgated under such Laws; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) any reference in this Agreement to a &#147;day&#148; or a number of &#147;days&#148; (without the explicit qualification of &#147;Business&#148;) shall be interpreted as a reference to a calendar day or number of
calendar days; </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(j) references to a Person are also to its successors and permitted assigns; and </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(k) the use of &#147;or&#148; is not intended to be exclusive unless expressly indicated otherwise. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:24px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">ARTICLE II </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">GOVERNANCE </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.01 <I>Share Capital</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">The
share capital of FoundryCo Outstanding as of the date hereof shall consist of (i)&nbsp;two (2)&nbsp;Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Shares, one each issued to Discovery and Oyster, respectively; (ii)&nbsp;no Class B Ordinary Shares; (iii)&nbsp;one million
three hundred nine thousand one hundred forty (1,309,140) Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares and (iv)&nbsp;eight hundred seventy-two thousand seven hundred sixty (872,760) Class B Preferred Shares. The rights of the holders of the Class&nbsp;A Ordinary
Shares, the Class B Ordinary Shares, the Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares and the Class B Preferred Shares are as set forth in the Memorandum and Articles of Association. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.02 <I>Voting</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) In accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of Association, prior
to the Reconciliation Event, the Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares, the Class B Preferred Shares and the Class B Ordinary Shares shall be non-voting and only the Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Shares shall have voting rights of one vote per Class&nbsp;A Ordinary
Share. Discovery and Oyster shall each be a holder of one Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Share and FoundryCo shall not issue any additional Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Shares. Following the Reconciliation Event and in accordance with the Memorandum and Articles of
Association, the Class&nbsp;A Ordinary Shares shall be automatically redeemed and the voting rights of the Class&nbsp;A Preferred Shares, the Class B Preferred Shares and the Class B Ordinary Shares shall be given effect. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">2 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Subject to the provisions set forth in the Memorandum and Articles of Association and this
<I>Section&nbsp;2.02</I>, each Shareholder then entitled to vote at a general meeting of shareholders of FoundryCo shall have the right to vote all Shares of which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall
otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof at any such meeting of shareholders, or execute a written resolution with respect to all Shares of which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall
otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.03 <I>Board of Directors</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) Prior to the Reconciliation Event, the Board shall consist of eight Directors, and Discovery and Oyster, each as a holder of one Class&nbsp;A
Ordinary Share, shall each be entitled to designate for nomination four (4)&nbsp;Directors. Prior to the Reconciliation Event, no Officers of FoundryCo shall sit on the Board. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Following the Reconciliation Event, the number of Persons a Shareholder may designate for nomination to serve as a Director shall be subject to
adjustment according to the percentage of Fully Diluted Shares held by such Shareholder as follows: (i)&nbsp;a Shareholder holding 30% or more but less than 40% of the Fully Diluted Shares shall be entitled to designate three (3)&nbsp;Directors;
(ii)&nbsp;a Shareholder holding 20% or more but less than 30% of the Fully Diluted Shares shall be entitled to designate two (2)&nbsp;Directors; (iii)&nbsp;a Shareholder holding 10% or more but less than 20% of the Fully Diluted Shares shall be
entitled to designate one (1)&nbsp;Director and (iv)&nbsp;a&nbsp;Shareholder holding less than 10% of the Fully Diluted Shares shall have no right pursuant to this Agreement to designate Persons for nomination to serve as Directors. To the extent
the number of Directors a Shareholder shall be entitled to nominate is reduced pursuant to this <I>Section&nbsp;2.03(b)</I>, then, so long as any other Shareholder owns at least a majority of the Fully Diluted Shares, such other Shareholder shall be
entitled to designate all of the remaining Directors. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) Each Shareholder shall make the nominations to which it is entitled hereunder at
least fifteen (15)&nbsp;days prior to each general meeting of shareholders of FoundryCo or, if FoundryCo elects not to hold a general meeting of shareholders, on or prior to the date on which FoundryCo&#146;s shareholders shall adopt a written
resolution with respect to the foregoing matters. Each Shareholder shall vote all Shares for which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof at
any general meeting of shareholders, or adopt a written resolution with respect to all Shares for which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof,
in favor of electing to the Board the nominees of Discovery and Oyster designated pursuant to <I>Sections 2.03(a)</I> and <I>(b)</I>. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(d)
Unless otherwise agreed in writing by Discovery and Oyster, the Chairman of the Board shall be a non-voting position held by a non-Director and the duties of the Chairman of the Board shall include: (i)&nbsp;providing guidance regarding the
long-term strategy of FoundryCo; (ii)&nbsp;developing external relationships with governmental organizations, customers and suppliers; (iii)&nbsp;representing FoundryCo at industry forums; (iv)&nbsp;shaping the agenda for the Board with input from
Oyster and Discovery; and (v)&nbsp;overseeing and driving the preparation phase of the Abu Dhabi fab build-out. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(e) No member of the Board
shall (i)&nbsp;have the ability to act unilaterally; (ii)&nbsp;veto any action of the Board or (iii)&nbsp;have the casting vote with respect to any matter to be voted upon by the Board. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(f) Board meetings may be called by any Board member upon three (3)&nbsp;days&#146; written notice to all other Board members. Such notice shall include
a written agenda for the subjects to be considered at such meeting. The Board may not act on any subject not specified in such agenda except (i)&nbsp;after receiving written waivers of such notice from all Board members who were not given such
notice and were not present at such meeting or (ii)&nbsp;upon such written consent or vote (including for such purposes, any express recusals) as may be required for such matters under this Agreement, the Memorandum and Articles of Association and
applicable Law, including the affirmative vote or express abstentions from voting of those Board members who were not given such notice. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">3 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(g) The Board shall conduct meetings no less frequently than quarterly and at such locations as a
majority of the members of the Board deem appropriate. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(h) Directors may participate in a meeting of the Board by means of a conference
telephone or other communication equipment through which all persons participating in the meeting can hear each other, which shall be provided at all Board meetings if requested by a Director, and such participation in a meeting shall constitute
presence in person at such meeting. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.04 <I>Removal of Board Members; Vacancies</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) A Shareholder may at any time elect to remove or dismiss any member of the Board appointed or nominated by such Shareholder pursuant to
<I>Section&nbsp;2.03</I>, with or without cause. Upon such election, each other Shareholder shall vote all Shares for which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct
the voting thereof at any such meeting of shareholders, or execute a written resolution with respect to all Shares for which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or
direct the voting thereof, in favor of the removal or dismissal of any such Board member. In the event that the number of members of the Board nominated by a Shareholder exceeds the number that such Shareholder has the right to nominate pursuant to
<I>Section&nbsp;2.03</I>, such Shareholder shall promptly take all appropriate action to cause any such extra members of the Board nominated by such Shareholder to immediately resign or alternatively shall take such measures as are necessary to
remove or dismiss such extra members. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) In the event that a vacancy occurs on the Board as a result of the retirement, removal,
dismissal, resignation, disability or death of a member thereof nominated pursuant to <I>Section&nbsp;2.03</I>, such vacancy shall be filled by a person nominated by the Shareholder whose nominee&#146;s retirement, removal, dismissal, resignation,
disability or death created such vacancy. Each Shareholder shall vote all Shares of which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof at any meeting
of shareholders, or execute a written resolution with respect to all Shares of which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof, in favor of the
election of any person so nominated to fill a vacancy on the Board. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) Each Shareholder hereby agrees that it will not vote (or execute
any written resolutions with respect to) any Shares of which it is the registered holder or any other Shares for which such Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof in favor of the removal, dismissal or
suspension of any member of the Board that any other Shareholder had the right to nominate unless such other Shareholder shall have consented to or requested such removal or dismissal in writing. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.05 <I>Committees</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a)
FoundryCo and each Shareholder hereby agree that there shall be established a people/compensation committee of the Board (the &#147;<I>People/Compensation Committee</I>&#148;), which shall make recommendations to the full Board for matters
including, but not limited to, management compensation, and the adoption of or amendment to FoundryCo benefits plans and Incentive Plans. The Board shall establish a People/Compensation Committee Charter setting forth in further detail the powers
and duties of the People/Compensation Committee. The People/Compensation Committee shall initially consist of at least two (2)&nbsp;members of the Board, including at least one Director nominated by Discovery and at least one Director nominated by
Oyster. The Chairman of the People/Compensation Committee shall be a Director nominated by Oyster initially and thereafter shall rotate annually between a Director nominated by Discovery and a Director nominated by Oyster. The People/Compensation
Committee shall meet no less frequently than quarterly at such place and time as shall be determined by the People/Compensation Committee Chairman. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">(b) FoundryCo and each Shareholder hereby agree that there shall be established a finance and audit committee of the Board (the &#147;<I>Finance and Audit Committee</I>&#148;), which shall assist the Board in its responsibilities </FONT>
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>
 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px" ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">4 </FONT></P>


<p Style='page-break-before:always'>
<HR  SIZE="3" COLOR="#999999" WIDTH="100%" ALIGN="CENTER">

 <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px">
<FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">relating to reviewing financial matters generally, including, but not limited to, the accounting and financial reporting processes of FoundryCo, the audits
of FoundryCo&#146;s consolidated financial statements, the qualifications of FoundryCo&#146;s independent auditor and the performance of FoundryCo&#146;s internal audit function and independent auditor. The Board shall establish a Finance and Audit
Committee Charter setting forth in further detail the powers and duties of the Finance and Audit Committee. The Finance and Audit Committee shall initially consist of at least two (2)&nbsp;members of the Board, including at least one Director
nominated by Discovery and at least one Director nominated by Oyster. The Chairman of the Finance and Audit Committee shall be a Director nominated by Discovery initially and thereafter shall rotate annually between a Director nominated by Oyster
and a Director nominated by Discovery. The Finance and Audit Committee shall meet no less frequently than quarterly at such place and time as shall be determined by the Finance and Audit Committee Chairman. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) FoundryCo and each Shareholder hereby agree that from time to time the Board may establish such other committees to assist the Board in its
responsibilities, including a security committee which shall oversee FoundryCo&#146;s compliance with any security and compliance-related commitments to the U.S. government as well as the overall security of FoundryCo, including the protection of
FoundryCo&#146;s technology and compliance with U.S. export control requirements. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.06 <I>Officers</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The Shareholders shall cause the Board to approve the appointment of the following initial senior executive officers of FoundryCo: (i)&nbsp;Doug
Grose as Chief Executive Officer; (ii)&nbsp;Bruce McDougall as Chief Financial Officer; and (iii)&nbsp;such other officers as determined and appointed by the People/Compensation Committee. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.07 <I>Additional Financings.</I> FoundryCo shall seek additional financing, and the Shareholders shall make additional capital
contributions, in accordance with the terms and conditions set forth in the Funding Agreement. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;2.08 <I>Certain Other
Corporate Actions</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) At all times, subject to <I>Section&nbsp;2.08(b)</I> and <I>Section&nbsp;6.01(b)</I>, FoundryCo shall not, and
shall cause its Subsidiaries not to, take (either directly or by amendment, merger, consolidation, reclassification or otherwise) (and each Shareholder agrees to vote all Shares for which such Shareholder is the registered holder or for which such
Shareholder shall otherwise have the ability to control or direct the voting thereof at any meeting of shareholders against (and to refuse to execute a written resolution that seeks the authority to approve)) any action not in the ordinary course of
business, unless the Board shall first have approved such action by Majority Vote; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Board may by resolution require prior notification or the Board&#146;s prior approval for any actions to be taken in the
ordinary course of business; <I>provided further</I>, that in the event a matter which would otherwise require approval under this <I>Section&nbsp;2.08</I> has been expressly included in either the Five-Year Capital Plan or the Annual Business Plan,

Securities are sold or otherwise disposed of by the Prospective Seller (A)&nbsp;within ninety (90)&nbsp;days after the expiration of the Offer Period or such longer period (up to the maximum period permitted by applicable Law) as would be required
under the HSR Act or other applicable Law, and (B)&nbsp;at a price not less than the Offer Price included in the Offer Notice. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman"
SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;3.06 <I>Right of Last Look</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The provisions of this <I>Section&nbsp;3.06</I> shall survive the IPO.
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Following the end of the Restricted Period, except as provided for in <I>Section&nbsp;3.03(b)</I>, a Prospective Seller shall not
consummate any Sale of Securities to a Third Party without offering in writing at least ten (10)&nbsp;Business Days prior to the consummation of the Sale of Securities, the Other Shareholder the right to acquire the Offered Securities for the
purchase price set forth in this <I>Section&nbsp;3.06</I> and otherwise on the terms and conditions offered by the Third Party (the &#147;<I>Last Look Notice</I>&#148;). The Last Look Notice shall contain (i)&nbsp;the name and address of the Third
Party and any Person who controls such Third Party, (ii)&nbsp;the proposed amount and form of consideration to be delivered by the Third Party in the transaction and a calculation of the purchase price applicable to the Other Shareholder,
(iii)&nbsp;the material terms of such transaction, and (iv)&nbsp;the proposed closing date. The Other Shareholder shall have five (5)&nbsp;Business Days to notify the Prospective Seller of its intentions to purchase the Securities on the terms and
conditions set forth above (the &#147;<I>Last Look Acceptance Notice</I>&#148;); </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(c) To the extent that the Other Shareholder elects not
to exercise its purchase right under this <I>Section&nbsp;3.06</I> or does not timely deliver a Last Look Acceptance Notice, the Prospective Seller shall be permitted to consummate its transaction with the Third Party not later than five
(5)&nbsp;Business Days after the expiration of the period of time for the Other Shareholder to deliver the Last Look Acceptance Notice. Alternatively, if the Other Shareholder timely delivers the Last Look Acceptance Notice, the Other Shareholder
must consummate the acquisition of Securities on or before the proposed closing date identified in the Last Look Notice. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;3.07
<I>Tag-Along Rights</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The provisions of this <I>Section&nbsp;3.07</I> shall terminate upon the IPO. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b)(i) Following the end of the Restricted Period, except as provided for in <I>Section&nbsp;3.03(b)</I>, no Prospective Seller shall sell any Offered
Securities held by it, if such Offered Securities constitute more than 10% of the then </FONT>

sell pursuant to such disposition up to the same percentage of Securities held by it as the percentage of Securities held by the Prospective Seller as the Prospective Seller proposes to sell. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(ii) The Other Shareholder desiring to exercise such option shall, prior to the expiration of the Offer Period, provide the Prospective
Seller with a written notice specifying the number of Securities as to which such Other Shareholder (the &#147;<I>Tag-Along Offered Securities</I>&#148;) has an interest in selling pursuant to the Tag-Along Offer (a &#147;<I>Tag-Along Notice of

Tag-Along Offer shall be made pro rata based on the number of Securities each Shareholder proposes to sell. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(iv) Promptly

the Securities of the Other Shareholder sold pursuant thereto less the <I>pro rata</I> portion (based on sales price of Securities being sold by the respective parties) of the out-of-pocket expenses (including reasonable legal expenses) incurred by
the Prospective Seller in connection with such sale; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Other Shareholder shall not be liable for any such expenses in the event that such sale is not consummated. </FONT></P> <P

HSR Act or other applicable Law), the Prospective Seller has not completed the sale of all the Tag-Along Offered Securities made available to the Prospective Seller pursuant to <I>Section&nbsp;3.07(b)(ii)</I>, the Prospective Seller shall return to
the Other Shareholder all certificates and documents provided to the Prospective Seller by the Other Shareholder pursuant to <I>Section&nbsp;3.07(b)(ii)</I>; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Prospective Seller shall not be relieved of its
obligation to sell the Securities of the Other Shareholder in the event that such sale is ultimately completed with such Third Party or Parties. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT

connection with this <I>Section&nbsp;3.07</I>. No Other Shareholder shall be entitled to sell and transfer Securities directly to any Third Party pursuant to a Tag-Along Offer (it being understood that all such sales shall be made only on the terms
and pursuant to the procedures set forth in this Section&nbsp;3.07). </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;3.08 <I>Drag-Along Rights</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The provisions of this <I>Section&nbsp;3.08</I> shall terminate upon the IPO. </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Following the end of the Restricted Period, except as provided for in <I>Section&nbsp;3.03(b)</I>, in the event that any Shareholder that, together
with its Permitted Transferees, holds at least 75% of the Fully Diluted Shares (the &#147;<I>Dragging-Along Shareholder</I>&#148;) proposes to sell all of its Securities in a bona fide transaction to a Third Party, then the Dragging-Along
Shareholder shall have the unconditional right to effect the sale of all (but not less than all) of such Securities in either a private or public sale, at the option of the Dragging-Along Shareholder (such transaction, the &#147;<I>Drag-Along
Transaction</I>&#148;). In such event, the Dragging-Along Shareholder may, at its option, require the other Shareholder (the &#147;<I>Dragged-Along Shareholder</I>&#148;) to sell all of the Securities then held by or registered in the names of such
Dragged-Along Shareholder and its Permitted Transferees (&#147;<I>Drag-Along Offered Securities</I>&#148;) to the Third Party or Parties in the Drag-Along Transaction for the same consideration and otherwise on the same terms and conditions upon
which the Dragging-Along Shareholder sells its Securities, subject to </FONT>

</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;6.01 <I>Deadlock Resolution Efforts</I> </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT

STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) With respect to all other matters requiring Board action hereunder, if a matter properly submitted to the Board fails to be resolved by the Board,
then during the twenty-one (21)&nbsp;day period following such deadlock, the Board shall seek in good faith to hold at least three (3)&nbsp;additional meetings in an attempt to resolve such deadlock. The additional meetings shall be held at the time
and place (including by telephonic conference) agreed to by the members of the Board. If after such twenty-one (21)&nbsp;day period such deadlock shall not have been resolved, then the Board shall submit the specific items that are the subject of
such deadlock to Discovery and Oyster, each acting through their chief executive officers, respectively, for resolution. A deadlock event shall be deemed to have lapsed if not resolved within thirty (30)&nbsp;days of referral to Discovery and Oyster
and FoundryCo shall continue to operate in accordance with the terms of this Agreement and in the manner which existed prior to the deadlock event occurring; <I>provided</I>, <I>however</I>, that the Shareholders agree that if: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) any Shareholder (together with its Permitted Transferees) owns at least 75% of the Fully Diluted Shares, then such Shareholder shall
be entitled to resolve the deadlock upon such lapse with respect to any action requiring a Majority Vote prior to the Reconciliation Event and with respect to each of the following: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(A) the amendment or restatement of its constituent documents, so long as, prior to the Reconciliation Event, such amendment or
restatement would not cause FoundryCo to fail to constitute a &#147;subsidiary&#148; of Discovery, as such term is defined in the Intel Patent Cross License Agreement; </FONT></P> <P

ALIGN="center"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">DISSOLUTION </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">SECTION&nbsp;7.01 <I>Dissolution.</I> </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(a) The Shareholders shall pass a special resolution approving the dissolution of FoundryCo upon the occurrence of any of the following: </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) by virtue of a written agreement to that effect, signed by Discovery and Oyster; </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(ii) the occurrence of any material event that makes it unlawful or illegal to carry on FoundryCo&#146;s business, which event is not able
to be cured after written notice has been given to the Shareholders specifying the details of such event; or </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(iii) at the
election by the other Shareholder (the &#147;<I>Non-Affected Shareholder</I>&#148;), (A)&nbsp;if either Discovery or Oyster (the &#147;<I>Affected Shareholder</I>&#148;): </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(1) commences a voluntary case under any Bankruptcy Law, </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(2) consents to the entry of an order for relief against it in an involuntary case under any Bankruptcy Law, </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(3) consents to the appointment of a Custodian of it or for all or substantially all of its property, </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(4) makes a general assignment for the benefit of its creditors, </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(5) generally is unable to pay its debts as the same become due, or </FONT></P> <P
STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(B) if a court of competent jurisdiction enters an order or decree, and such order or decree remains unstayed and in effect for sixty
(60)&nbsp;days, under any Bankruptcy Law that: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(1) is for relief against the Affected Shareholder in an involuntary case,
</FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(2) appoints a Custodian of the Affected Shareholder or for all or substantially all of its property,&nbsp;or </FONT></P>
<P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:8%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(3) orders the liquidation of the Affected Shareholder. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%"><FONT
FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">For the purposes of this <I>Section&nbsp;7.01</I>, the term &#147;<I>Bankruptcy Law</I>&#148; means title 11, U.S. Code or any similar foreign, federal or state law for the relief of debtors. The term
&#147;<I>Custodian</I>&#148; means any receiver, trustee, assignee, liquidation or similar official under any Bankruptcy Law. </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:12px;margin-bottom:0px; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(b) Upon the
occurrence of any of the events set forth in <I>Section&nbsp;7.01(a)(iii) (A)</I>&nbsp;and <I>(B)</I>, the Non-Affected Shareholder may elect in lieu of triggering the dissolution of FoundryCo pursuant to <I>Section&nbsp;7.01(a)(iii)</I> any or all
of the following actions: </FONT></P> <P STYLE="margin-top:6px;margin-bottom:0px; margin-left:4%; text-indent:4%"><FONT FACE="Times New Roman" SIZE="2">(i) upon notice to FoundryCo by the Non-Affected Shareholder, the rights of the Directors
designated by the Affected Shareholder (each an &#147;<I>Affected Director</I>&#148;) under <I>Section&nbsp;2.08(b)</I> shall terminate and all actions set forth under <I>Section&nbsp;2.08(b)</I> shall require the approval of each Director
designated by the Non-Affected Shareholder (each a &#147;<I>Non-Affected Director</I>&#148;) with each Affected Director recusing themselves from such vote and upon such approval, the matter shall be deemed approved by the Board; <I>provided</I>,
<I>however</I>, that the rights of each Affected Director under <I>Section&nbsp;2.08(b)(i)</I> shall survive if, prior to </FONT>
</P> <P STYLE="margin-top:0px;margin-bottom:0px"><FONT SIZE="1">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

winding-up of FoundryCo shall immediately commence to wind up FoundryCo&#146;s affairs in accordance with applicable Law and the Memorandum and Articles of Association; <I>provided, however</I>, that a reasonable time shall be allowed for the
